panels.title: Streams missing a required label
panels.description: One row per non-conforming stream; the same set Drilldown shows as `unknown_service`. Queried on `app` directly so it holds regardless of Loki's `discover_service_name` limit. The cluster-events source is exempt and filtered out; loki-canary carries no `cluster` and is invisible here by construction.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (namespace, job, container, pod) (count_over_time({cluster="nyx", job!="kubernetes/events", app=""}[$__range])), "missing", "app", "", "") or label_replace(sum by (namespace, job, container, pod) (count_over_time({cluster="nyx", job!="kubernetes/events", namespace=""}[$__range])), "missing", "namespace", "", "") or label_replace(sum by (namespace, job, container, pod) (count_over_time({cluster="nyx", job!="kubernetes/events", container=""}[$__range])), "missing", "container", "", "") or label_replace(sum by (namespace, job, container, pod) (count_over_time({cluster="nyx", job!="kubernetes/events", job=""}[$__range])), "missing", "job", "", "")

panels.title: Out-of-convention labels in the index
panels.description: Lines carrying a label the convention puts in structured metadata, or excludes outright. This is a scale indicator rather than an outlier list — every pod stream currently carries all of these.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum(count_over_time({cluster="nyx", instance=~".+"}[$__range])), "label", "instance", "", "") or label_replace(sum(count_over_time({cluster="nyx", pod=~".+"}[$__range])), "label", "pod", "", "") or label_replace(sum(count_over_time({cluster="nyx", node=~".+"}[$__range])), "label", "node", "", "") or label_replace(sum(count_over_time({cluster="nyx", container_runtime=~".+"}[$__range])), "label", "container_runtime", "", "")

panels.title: Targets missing a required label
panels.description: Scrape targets lacking one of the five universal labels, counted from `up` so it measures targets rather than series — recording rules and kube-state-metrics both drop target labels legitimately. Empty is the expected state; a row means a monitor landed without the operator's standard relabeling.

targets.expr: label_replace(count by (job) (up{job=""}), "missing", "job", "", "") or label_replace(count by (job) (up{instance=""}), "missing", "instance", "", "") or label_replace(count by (job) (up{namespace=""}), "missing", "namespace", "", "") or label_replace(count by (job) (up{service=""}), "missing", "service", "", "") or label_replace(count by (job) (up{endpoint=""}), "missing", "endpoint", "", "")

panels.title: Label collisions
panels.description: Series where the exposition carried a label the scrape also sets, so Prometheus renamed the exposed one to `exported_*`. Correct for an exporter reporting on itself, wrong for one reporting on something else.

targets.expr: label_replace(count by (job) ({exported_job!=""}), "collision", "job", "", "") or label_replace(count by (job) ({exported_instance!=""}), "collision", "instance", "", "") or label_replace(count by (job) ({exported_namespace!=""}), "collision", "namespace", "", "") or label_replace(count by (job) ({exported_service!=""}), "collision", "service", "", "") or label_replace(count by (job) ({exported_pod!=""}), "collision", "pod", "", "") or label_replace(count by (job) ({exported_endpoint!=""}), "collision", "endpoint", "", "")
